title: Isotropic Coordinates for Generalized Schwarzschild-like Solutions
summary: We consider a broad class of static, spherically symmetric generalized Schwarzschild-like solutions with multiple non-interacting anisotropic fluid sources and derive the coordinate transformation from Schwarzschild-like (curvature) to isotropic coordinates with conformally flat spatial slices.
